newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn approves Uzbek, Vietnam air accords.
newsitem.headline: Bonn approves Uzbek, Vietnam air accords.

text.p: The German cabinet has approved bills to bring new air accords with Uzbekistan and Vietnam into law, the country's transport ministry said in a statement.
The bills regulate accords signed with the Uzbek government on November 16, 1995, and with the Vietnamese government on August 26, 1994, the statement said.
The accords grant each state the right to transport passengers, cargo, baggage and post between the two countries as well as overhead flight rights.
Deutsche Lufthansa AG and Uzbekistan Airways each fly three times a week between Frankfurt and Tashkent at present.
Between Germany and Vietnam there are two weekly Lufthansa Frankfurt-Ho Chi Minh City services and a weekly Vietnam Airlines flight from Hanoi via Dubai and Paris to Berlin Tegel, the ministry said.

These services operate on the basis of a Lufthansa-Vietnam Airlines agreement but the new accord will aid the opening up of Vietnam to the outside world, it added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
